item.title: Azure Site Recovery — Cross-Vault Access Control Flaw Enabling Unauthorized Replication Inventory Access (CVE-2026-118286)
item.description: Critical severity (CVSS 9.1) — cloud · CVE-2026-118286. Status: PoC. Affects: Microsoft Azure Site Recovery (hosted service; Recovery Services vaults and replication-protected items in the Azure management plane). Tags: Azure, Azure Site Recovery, access-control, CWE-284, cross-vault, IDOR, cloud, enumeration, management-plane, privilege-escalation.
